_why_two_claims: AGREEMENT asks whether the engines compute the same thing; RECOVERY asks whether they compute the right thing. Agreement alone passes identical mistakes. Recovery alone passes a default mismatch smaller than sampling error.
_why_not_self_generated: Expected values are not recorded from running this code. The fixture draws the outcome from a LOG-LINK risk model, which is exactly the parameter modified Poisson targets, so the truth is a property of the data rather than of any implementation.

agreement.claim: every executed engine reproduces the same estimates AND the same HC0 robust standard error
agreement._note: The SE tolerance is the point of this entry. sandwich::vcovHC defaults to HC3 and statsmodels GLM defaults to the nonrobust model-based covariance, so two files that both look like Zou's method can report different intervals. Both are pinned to HC0 and this check is what holds them there.

recovery.claim: the estimate is close to the risk ratio the fixture used
recovery._note: PROVISIONAL. Roughly three standard errors under a rough SE of about 0.04 for 3000 rows at 12% event rate. Nothing has run the model. Reset this against the observed SE on the first green run.

stata.reason: no Stata licence; and vce(robust) applies a finite-sample correction, so its SE would need its own tolerance rather than HC0's
